items.title: The life and death of the Ahmed Abbas 714 building in Beirut
items.description: The residential building was destroyed on March 18 by an Israeli airstrike. Israel claimed, without providing evidence, that Hezbollah money was being hidden in its basement. With the destruction of these 36 apartments, a piece of Lebanese life has vanished.

items.title: Leader of Hamas's armed wing killed in strike on Gaza, says Israel
items.description: The Israeli military said on Saturday that it had killed the head of Hamas's military wing Ezzedine Al-Haddad during an air strike carried out the previous day in Gaza. Haddad's wife and daughter were also killed in the attack, according to a Hamas source.

items.title: 'The Strike Hit Right Above Us': A Night Under Russian Bombs In Dobropillya
items.description: Russia is preparing to assault the city of Dobropillya, according to Ukraine’s military. Located a few kilometers from the front line, the city is burning and being destroyed by bombs, artillery, and drones. Despite daily shelling, some civilians flatly refuse to leave and remain in Dobropillya.

items.title: Kremlin Rejects EU Mediation in Ukraine Peace Talks
items.description: Top spokesman Dmitry Peskov accused Brussels of being a “direct participant” in the war due to its continued support of Ukraine.
